name: jero_worker_mips
note: Simulated worker node — no real server behind it. This file carries the PUBLIC identity only (node_id, fingerprint, pubkey). The secret (identity.dat) is never shipped in a release; it lives on the operator's box at mya-node/workers/jero_worker_mips/data/. Do not announce it to node.darknet.ca unless the operator says so; it cannot answer live jobs. For transfer tests, address signed transfer containers to its pubkey directly.
purpose: Worker node for node-to-node knowledge transfer tests. Receives and holds the night-shift knowledge bundle (ETH, Bitcoin, and project-relevant tech researched 2026-11-08) so a node can test transferring knowledge to it and querying it back.
